QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Long Held Secret
QuestInfo.0: There is no relic inside, only a strange miasma and an old parchment containing cryptograms. Maybe Sieg can explain.
QuestInfo.1: Sieg decodes the cryptogram, revealing the contents of the chests. The miasma was actually #rpestilence#k sealed by the priests of Tallahart long ago! Relay this info to Aoe.
QuestInfo.2: Aoe was shocked to learn what was in the chests.
